plotTitle: Garden of Demons: The Wraithwood Blight
mainObjective: Unravel the origin of the demonic corruption twisting Wraithwood Forest and its surrounding lands, forging alliances and overcoming haunted trials to break the curse before the darkness consumes all.

plotPoints.title: Shadows Over Lanternstream
plotPoints.description: The party arrives in Gloamreach Village (GV001), greeted by Elder Maelis, who explains that a creeping gloom and unsettling disappearances plague the town. To uncover the cause of the curse, the party must investigate haunted landmarks, question villagers, and explore the lantern-lit streets, gathering clues that hint at a spreading corruption from the surrounding wilds. Clues found here will lead the party towards the dangerous Blightfen Wilds and beyond.
plotPoints.plotImpact: Establishes the central mystery and introduces key NPCs in Gloamreach Village. The clues and relationships forged here shape access to allies and information in future areas.

sideQuests.title: The Flickering Watch
sideQuests.description: Investigate the nightly extinguishing of lanterns near the old footbridge and help the lamplighter ease the villagers’ fears.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Earns trust and provides further clues about the haunting shadows.

sideQuests.title: The Willow-Sick Child
sideQuests.description: Help cure a child sickened by the cursed ponds, seeking rare wildflowers and learning about the blight’s unnatural energies.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Grants a grateful contact and dream-wrought hints about the corruption’s source.

plotPoints.title: Into the Blightfen Outlands
plotPoints.description: Clues from Gloamreach point to the Blightfen Wilds (BO002) as the origin of the corruption. The party ventures into these swampy, overgrown fields, facing natural hazards and supernatural foes. They must track the blight’s source, interact with strange hermits, and possibly the Thornkin Rella, discovering that the corruption is tied to a deeper force connected to the forest’s ancient heart. Success here uncovers the link between the blight and a corrupted Heartbloom, and hints at a broader demonic influence.
plotPoints.plotImpact: Navigating the Outlands and negotiating with denizens provides crucial lore and resources for future challenges.

sideQuests.title: Moonbow’s Message
sideQuests.description: Lay a spectral child’s spirit to rest by retrieving her lost locket, revealing secrets of the region’s haunting.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Grants a protective charm or a critical clue about the entity behind the gloom.

sideQuests.title: Hermit’s Bargain
sideQuests.description: Help the reclusive druid Whisperroot repel blightbeasts from her grove in exchange for cryptic assistance.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Rewards include potions, lore, or a shortcut deeper into the fens.

plotPoints.title: Signs of Rot and Resistance
plotPoints.description: Deeper in the Blightfen Wilds (BO002), unnatural flora and undead beasts reveal the depth of the blight. The party encounters wary fenfolk and outcast druids who reveal that a cursed Heartbloom beneath the Marsh King’s Cairn is fueling the corruption. The party must decide to ally with the locals for assistance or press ahead alone. Success here grants the information and resources to approach the Cairn and face the heart of the corruption.
plotPoints.plotImpact: Forges alliances and reveals the central threat in the Blightfen, setting up the confrontation at the Cairn.

sideQuests.title: The Croaking Pact
sideQuests.description: Rescue the 'Egg-Prince' of a chorus of giant frogs from a sinister hag for a magical anti-blight charm.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Success earns blight resistance; failure may antagonize swamp denizens.

sideQuests.title: Plague-Bound Spirits
sideQuests.description: Lay cursed spirits to rest by finding their burial tokens, weakening the undead near the Cairn.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Clearing the spirits eases access to the Marsh King’s Cairn.

plotPoints.title: The Marsh King’s Cairn
plotPoints.description: Guided by clues and alliances, the party infiltrates the heart of the Blightfen’s darkness: the ruined barrow of the Marsh King (BO002). Here, infernal corruption entwines with ancient druidic wards. The party must confront blighted guardians and solve environmental puzzles to reach the Heartbloom. Choices regarding the Marsh King’s desperate spirit and the fate of the Heartbloom set the tone for the region’s future and reveal that the blight is spreading further, toward the Twisted Wilds.
plotPoints.plotImpact: The party’s actions determine if the Blightfen is healed, changed, or left vulnerable, and point toward the next corrupted region.

sideQuests.title: Whispers Beneath the Cairn
sideQuests.description: Interpret ethereal runes to learn about the Marsh King’s pact and how to weaken or purify the Heartbloom.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Unlocks advantages for the Cairn’s final encounter and possible redemption for the Marsh King’s spirit.

plotPoints.title: Purging the Heartbloom
plotPoints.description: In the heart of the Marsh King’s Cairn (BO002), the party faces the corrupted Heartbloom—a monstrous, sentient plant fused with infernal energy. The final battle here demands strategy, courage, and possibly the aid of uneasy allies. The party’s choices—purification, destruction, or claiming the Heartbloom’s power—will affect the land’s fate and the nature of the spreading corruption into the Twisted Wilds.
plotPoints.plotImpact: Climactic battle resolves the Blightfen’s curse and transitions the threat to the Twisted Wilds.

plotPoints.title: Crossing the Twisted Wilds
plotPoints.description: Fresh from the struggles in the Blightfen, the party follows signs of the corruption’s advance into the Twisted Wilds (TTW003). The forest is a labyrinth of warped thickets and ancient oaks, now haunted by a profane influence. Here, the party must navigate treacherous paths while evading Gravenbark Guardians and encountering the Shade of Alenwen—a remnant of the Wilds’ former protector. Choices here—alliances or confrontations—will shape the party’s resources and allies for the climactic confrontation.
plotPoints.plotImpact: Tests resourcefulness and diplomacy, affecting the outcome and support in the upcoming trials.

sideQuests.title: Relics of the Old Grove
sideQuests.description: Recover hidden druidic relics to weaken Wilds' guardians or gain favor with the surviving druids.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Turns foes into allies or grants magical aid for the climax.

sideQuests.title: Bargain with the Shade
sideQuests.description: Persuade or banish the Shade of Alenwen for guidance or warnings about the final threat.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Gaining her aid opens tactical advantages or secret passages in the final area.

plotPoints.title: Echoes of Old Power
plotPoints.description: Deeper within the Twisted Wilds (TTW003), the party encounters restless spirits and evidence of ancient druidic rituals. Negotiating with or confronting the Shade of Alenwen reveals that the heart of the corruption lies ahead, guarded by unnatural forces. The party learns the demonic influence is attempting to merge the Feywild with the material realm, threatening the balance of all Wraithwood.
plotPoints.plotImpact: Reveals the true stakes and sets up the final journey into the Wilds’ corrupted heart.

sideQuests.title: Spectral Bargain
sideQuests.description: Appease or banish minor spirits haunting a ruined altar to learn forbidden rites or gain a magical boon.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Alters future encounters and may provide boons or complications.

plotPoints.title: The Heart of Thorns
plotPoints.description: Guided by vision and lore, the party descends into the core of the Twisted Wilds (TTW003), where the corruption is thickest. They must survive the attacks of Gravenbark Guardians and navigate a bramble maze to confront a profane relic channeling demonic energy. The decisions made here—whether to destroy, purify, or harness the relic—set the stage for the climactic confrontation and the fate of the Wilds.
plotPoints.plotImpact: Direct confrontation with the source of the corruption, with outcomes affecting the final area.

sideQuests.title: Seeds of Rebirth
sideQuests.description: Help the surviving druids reclaim sacred seeds hidden in the maze to heal the Wilds or gain new allies.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Aids in purifying the forest or provides new allies for the final battle.

sideQuests.title: The Old Pact
sideQuests.description: Decide whether to release a cunning fiend imprisoned beneath the relic for forbidden knowledge.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Grants knowledge or resources but may unleash a future threat.

plotPoints.title: Rite of Cleansing
plotPoints.description: At the corrupted heart, the party must disrupt the relic’s power through ancient rites, battle, or negotiation with the Manifestation of the Forest's Spirit (TTW003). The outcome depends on alliances and choices made in previous areas. The fate of the Twisted Wilds—and the entire Wraithwood—now hangs in the balance.
plotPoints.plotImpact: Delivers the climax and alters the fate of the Twisted Wilds, opening the path to the Thornwound Wilds.

sideQuests.title: Last Stand of the Guardians
sideQuests.description: Defend the surviving druids against a final wave of corrupted Gravenbark Guardians to secure the ritual site.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Influences the ritual’s success and the Wilds’ future.

plotPoints.title: The Thornwound Wilds Beckon
plotPoints.description: With the Twisted Wilds cleansed or changed, word reaches the party of a new threat: the Thornwound Wilds (SOT004), where travelers vanish and predatory horrors roam. A dying messenger tells of a demon-bloom at the heart of the Wilds. The party is commissioned to investigate, map the region, and uncover the source before it overruns the region. Their preparation and approach will determine their chances within the treacherous bramble labyrinth.
plotPoints.plotImpact: Sets the stakes for the final area and allows the party to gather tools and lore for survival.

sideQuests.title: Gather Lore from the Thorn-Touched
sideQuests.description: Seek out hermits and survivors who have entered the Wilds for survival tips or a protective talisman.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Can grant maps or items vital for navigating the Thornwound Wilds.

sideQuests.title: Procure Antivenom and Supplies
sideQuests.description: Negotiate for antivenoms and bramble-cutting tools from local traders.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Secures resources to mitigate natural hazards.

plotPoints.title: Labyrinth of Blood and Thorns
plotPoints.description: The party enters the Thornwound Wilds (SOT004), facing deadly undergrowth, illusions, and predatory fauna. The Wilds react to their presence, luring them into traps and testing their resolve. Allies found or choices made here will determine the party’s path to the Wilds’ heart and the final confrontation.
plotPoints.plotImpact: Survival and exploration are key; the party’s actions affect the ease of reaching the heart of the Wilds.

sideQuests.title: The Lost Band
sideQuests.description: Rescue stranded fortune-seekers whose camp is besieged by venomous predators for aid or information.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Can grant a guide, information, or a magical token.

sideQuests.title: The Ensnared Fey
sideQuests.description: Free a trapped fey creature from the brambles’ magic for a blessing or guidance.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Assistance from the fey reveals hidden dangers or offers aid, but may incur obligations.

plotPoints.title: The Heart’s Corruption
plotPoints.description: Deep in the maze of Thornwound Wilds (SOT004), the party discovers a demon-bloom nourished by a corrupted druidic circle. They must unravel the druids’ enchantments, confront the cult, and decide whether the Wilds can be healed, contained, or must be destroyed. Their choices will have lasting repercussions on the land and its spirits.
plotPoints.plotImpact: The fate of the Thornwound Wilds and the druidic circle are decided here, echoing throughout the region.

sideQuests.title: Seeds of Redemption
sideQuests.description: Attempt to redeem a corrupted druid and learn the true origins of the demon-bloom.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Redemption grants lore and magical aid for the final confrontation.

sideQuests.title: Sabotage the Root-Tendrils
sideQuests.description: Destroy infernal roots to weaken the bloom’s guardians and disrupt its power.
sideQuests.plotImpact: Weakening the bloom’s defenses makes the final battle easier or may destabilize the Wilds.

plotPoints.title: Exodus or Exorcism
plotPoints.description: At the climax in the heart of the Thornwound Wilds (SOT004), the party must perform a ritual of cleansing, broker a pact with ancient spirits, or flee before the Wilds collapse. Fey, survivors, and druidic spirits all plead for different resolutions. The fate of Wraithwood—and its future—rests in the party’s hands. Will the Garden of Demons be banished, transformed, or left to fester?
plotPoints.plotImpact: Final resolution and long-term consequences for the region, setting up future adventures or ongoing threats.

sideQuests.title: Bargain with the Old Spirits
sideQuests.description: Negotiate with the ancient spirit of the Wilds for its blessing, forgiveness, or a promise of safety.
sideQuests.plotImpact: A successful bargain can heal the land, while failure may doom it to perpetual blight.
